title: The Perfect Witness
author: Rosalind Brightwater
blurb: Theo Sterling, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
